BURSEVI:v10p316/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p316/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p316/r4.claim: The most wretched turns away from the reminder and refuses to listen receptively; this may denote especially hostile leaders or all unbelievers as worse than sinners.
BURSEVI:v10p316/r4.anchor: {ويتجنبها} أي يتبعد من الذكرى ولا يسمعها سماع القبول

BURSEVI:v10p316/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p316/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p316/r5.claim: A report says a hypocrite refused to trade a date palm for one in Paradise, so Uthman gave the petitioner his own orchard and the verse was revealed.
BURSEVI:v10p316/r5.anchor: وروى أن من يخشى هو عثمان بن عفان رضي الله عنه وإلا شقى رجل من المنافقين

BURSEVI:v10p316/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p316/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p316/r6.claim: Two related stories contrast a man who chose eighty sheep over Paradise with an old woman who preferred Paradise to a hundred sheep for revealing Joseph's bones to Moses.
BURSEVI:v10p316/r6.anchor: ونظيره إن رجلا قضى النبي عليه السلام حاجة فقال ائتني بالمدينة

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417#2/r1.speaker: قتادة
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417#2/r1.claim: Qatada says anyone who fears God remembers Him, while one who turns from the reminder out of disdain or hostility to it and its people is among the most wretched.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417#2/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله : سيذكر من يخشى ويتجنبها الاشقى قال : والله ما خشي الله عبد قط الا ذكره

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r7.claim: Tajannub means deliberately placing oneself to the side of something; here it pictures the most wretched person keeping far away from the reminder.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r7.anchor: والتجنب : التباعد ، وأصله تفعل لتكلف الكينونة بجانبب من شيء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r8.claim: Al-ashqā is generic and means those most wretched; in religious usage, wretchedness is the afterlife misery caused by disbelief, and a believer who dies in faith is not wretched.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r8.anchor: الأشقى } : هو الشديد الشقوة ، والشقوة والشقاء في لسان الشرع الحالة الناشئة في الآخرة عن الكفر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r9.claim: The generic most-wretched person is the unbeliever, including all polytheists, though some exegetes restrict it to al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra or ʿUtba b. Rabīʿa.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p285/r9.anchor: ومن المفسرين من حمله على العهد فقال : أريد به الوليد بن المغيرة ، أو عتبة بن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p286/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p286/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p286/r1.claim: Contrasting the one who fears with the most wretched implies the latter is heedless in delusion and pleasure, seeking no escape from misery.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p286/r1.anchor: ومقابلة { من يخشى } ب { الأشقى } تؤذن بأن { الأشقى } من شأنه أن لا يخشى

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p90#4/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p90#4/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p90#4/r1.claim: The most wretched person avoids the reminder.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p91/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p91/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p91/r1.claim: The wretched person will enter the great Fire, great and dreadful because it is more severe than the fire of this world.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p91/r1.anchor: الذي يصلى النار الكبرى أي العظيمة الفظيعة لأنها أشد من نار الدنيا

JISHUMI:v10p7378/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7378/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7378/r4.claim: Tajannub is turning to one side, away from something that conflicts with it; shaqwa is a condition leading to severe punishment, opposite felicity.
JISHUMI:v10p7378/r4.anchor: والتجنب: المصير في جانب من الشيء بما ينافي غيره

JISHUMI:v10p7380/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7380/r13.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7380/r13.claim: The wretched person’s turning away is his own act and he can do otherwise, so it is blameworthy; this refutes the determinists’ doctrine of created human acts and capacity.
JISHUMI:v10p7380/r13.anchor: أن التجنب فعله، وأنه يقدر على خلافه؛ لذلك صح ذمه

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r6.claim: The most wretched who avoids the reminder is the unbeliever, or the most wicked unbeliever because of deep hostility toward the Messenger; some say the verse was revealed about al-Walid and Utba.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r7.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r7.claim: An unnamed report says the passage was revealed about al-Walid ibn al-Mughira and Utba ibn Rabi'a.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r7.anchor: نزلت في الوليد بن المغيرة وعتبة بن ربيعة

MUQATIL:87:8-13/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:87:8-13/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:87:8-13/r4.claim: The most wretched person treats monotheism lightly or neglects it.
MUQATIL:87:8-13/r4.anchor: يقول: ويتهاون بها، يعني بالتوحيد الأشقى

NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#11/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#11/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#11/r1.claim: The most wretched person turns away from the reminder and does not accept it.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#11/r1.anchor: ويتباعد عن الذكرى فلا يقبلها ﴿ الأشقى ﴾ الكافر

NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#11/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#11/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#11/r2.claim: “Most wretched” may mean an unbeliever generally or the most deeply unbelieving because of his intense hostility to the Messenger; it is said to have been revealed about al-Walid ibn al-Mughira and Utba ibn Rabi'a.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#11/r2.anchor: الكافر أو الذى هو أشقى الكفر لتوغله فى عداوة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قيل نزلت فى الوليد

QURTUBI-FULL:87:11-13/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:87:11-13/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:87:11-13/r1.claim: The most wretched person turns away from the reminder; some say the verse concerns al-Walid ibn al-Mughira and ʿUtba ibn Rabiʿa.
QURTUBI-FULL:87:11-13/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى: { ويتجنبها } أي ويتجنب الذكرى ويبعد عنها. { الأشقى } أي الشقي في علم الله.

QURTUBI-FULL:87:14-15#2/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:87:14-15#2/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:87:14-15#2/r1.claim: The preceding warning that the most wretched will avoid the reminder is also said to have been revealed about a hypocrite.

QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.claim: Al-Aʿla is Meccan and has nineteen verses; the Prophet loved it, recited it at Eid and Friday prayers with al-Ghashiya, sometimes on the same day.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.anchor: سورة الأعلى مكية وآياتها تسع عشرة

QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.claim: The surah turns the entire cosmos into a sanctuary reverberating with praise and offers the Prophet good news of divine preservation and ease in his mission and affairs.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.anchor: وحق لرسول الله [ صلى الله عليه وسلم ] أن يحب هذه السورة وهي تحيل له الكون كله معبدا

QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.claim: Its foundations are God's oneness as creator, divine revelation, and afterlife recompense, rooted in earlier scriptures; it also portrays the easy nature of the message, messenger, and community.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.anchor: وهي تتضمن الثابت من قواعد التصور الإيماني

QUTB-ZILAL:87:10/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:10/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:10/r1.claim: The Prophet fulfills his duty by reminding; people then diverge in response and outcome, and God deals with them according to how they receive the reminder.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:10/r1.anchor: فإذا نهض [ صلى الله عليه وسلم ] بهذا العبء فقد أدى ما عليه

QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r1.claim: The wretched person avoids reminder and refuses to hear or benefit from it; al-ashqa names the absolute endpoint of wretchedness.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r1.anchor: يتجنب الذكرى ، فلا يسمع لها ولا يفيد منها

QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r2.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r2.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r2.claim: In this life the utterly wretched has a dead, dull soul that cannot sense existence's truths or respond to its signs and lives anxiously grasping at trivial worldly concerns.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r2.anchor: الأشقى في الدنيا بروحه الخاوية الميتة الكثيفة الصفيقة

QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r3.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r3.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r3.claim: His afterlife is made wretched by punishment without known end, described in the following verses.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:11/r3.anchor: والأشقى في الآخرة بعذابها الذي لا يعرف له مدى

RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r1.claim: Of the knowing, hesitant, and defiant groups, the most wretched is the obstinate person who ignores the call and gains no benefit from it.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r1.anchor: الأشقى هو المعاند الذي لا يستمع إلى الدعوة ولا ينتفع بها

RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r2.speaker: الحسن
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r2.claim: The greater fire is Hell, in contrast with the lesser fire of this world.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r2.anchor: قال الحسن : الكبرى نار جهنم ، والصغرى نار الدنيا

RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r3.claim: Another interpretation is that the afterlife contains fires and levels of differing severity, and the worst sinner enters the greatest fire.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r3.anchor: أن في الآخرة نيرانا ودركات متفاضلة كماأن في الدنيا ذنوبا

RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r4.claim: A third interpretation makes the greater fire the lowest level, where disbelievers are placed, as 4:145 says of hypocrites.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r4.anchor: النار الكبرى هي النار السفلى ، وهي تصيب الكفار

RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r5.claim: Reports tie the revelation to al-Walid, Utba, and Abi, but the wording applies generally and the sequence is also rationally established.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r5.anchor: نزلت هذه الآية في الوليد وعتبة وأبي ، وأنت تعلم أن العبرة بعموم اللفظ لا بخصوص السبب

RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r6.claim: The superlative does not require a separate class of merely wretched people; Arabic can use it without comparison, as 25:24 does.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r6.anchor: لفظة الأشقى لا تقتضي وجود الشقي إذ قد يجري مثل هذا اللفظ من غير مشاركة

RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r7.claim: An alternative construes the word as the wretched one, like 30:27 meaning easy; an Arabic poetic line is also cited for this usage.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r7.anchor: وقيل : المعنى ، ويتجنبها الشقي الذي يصلى كما في قوله : { وهو أهون عليه

RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r8.claim: The sound account keeps three classes: the knower is felicitous, the hesitant has some misery, and the obstinate who spurns the call is most wretched.
RAZI-FULL:v31p132#2/r8.anchor: السعيد هو العارف ، والمتوقف له بعض الشقاء والأشقى هو المعاند

SAMIN-DURR:87:11/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:87:11/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:87:11/r1.claim: The object pronoun in yat ajannabuhā refers to the reminder.

STUDYQURAN:87:10/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:87:10/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:87:10/r1.claim: Those certain of returning to God, and those who admit it without certainty, fear God; deniers of the return are the most wretched.
STUDYQURAN:87:10/r1.anchor: Those who are certain of the return to God and those who admit to it but are not certain of it are those who fear God

TAB-FULL:v24p317/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p317/r2.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v24p317/r2.claim: Qatāda says God-fearing people remember, while anyone who avoids the reminder out of contempt for it and its people is wretched.
TAB-FULL:v24p317/r2.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله: " {فذكر إن نفعت الذكرى سيذكر من يخشى} [الأعلى: 10] فاتقوا الله، ما خشي الله عبد قط إلا ذكره

TABATABAI:87:14-16/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:87:14-16/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:87:14-16/r6.claim: By contrast, the most wretched is one with no fear of God, who keeps away from the reminder.
TABATABAI:87:14-16/r6.anchor: والمراد بالأشقى بقرينة المقابلة من ليس في قلبه شيء من خشية الله تعالى

TABRISI:87:10-17/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:87:10-17/r2.speaker: author
TABRISI:87:10-17/r2.claim: The most wretched avoids the reminder; the worst are sinners who disbelieve in God and worship another.
TABRISI:87:10-17/r2.anchor: فأعظمهم درجة فيها الذي كفر بالله وتوحيده وعبد غيره

TABRISI:87:10-17/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:87:10-17/r3.speaker: أبو مسلم
TABRISI:87:10-17/r3.claim: Abū Muslim reads “most wretched” comparatively as the worse of the two groups, those who fear and those who avoid.
TABRISI:87:10-17/r3.anchor: الأشقى من الاثنين من يخشى ومن يتجنب عن أبي مسلم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r4.speaker: الفراء، الزجاج
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r4.claim: The pronoun in “avoids it” refers to the reminder.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p443/r4.anchor: {ويتجنبها} (¬1) يعني: ويتجنب الذكرى، قاله الفراء (¬2)، والزجاج

WAHIDI-QT:87:11/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-QT:87:11/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-QT:87:11/r1.claim: The wretched one, as known to God's foreknowledge, avoids and withdraws from the reminder.
WAHIDI-QT:87:11/r1.anchor: ويتجنب الذكرى ويتباعد عنها { الأشقى } في علم الله

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:87:7-16/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:87:7-16/r7.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:87:7-16/r7.claim: The most wretched, as known to God, avoids and distances himself from the reminder.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:87:7-16/r7.anchor: ويتجنب الذكرى ويتباعد عنها { الأشقى } في علم الله.

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r1.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r1.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r1.claim: The pronoun refers back to the admonition in verse 9; Paret compares Q 92:17 with subject and object reversed, referring there to Hellfire.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r1.anchor: Das Pronomen bezieht such auf „die Mahnung“ (aḏ-ḏikrā) aus V. 9 zurück

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r2.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r2.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r2.claim: Al-ašqā names the damned in early Meccan Q 92:15; its use for the Thamūd compatriot at Q 91:12 may also carry an eschatological threat.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r2.anchor: auch wenn der Kontext hier nicht eschatologisch ist, so dürfte der Ausdruck angesichts seiner Verwendung in Q 87 und 92

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r3.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r3.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r3.claim: The elative ašqā disappears from later texts, where the positive shaqiyy occurs in Q 19 and Q 11.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:11:anmerkung/r3.anchor: In späteren Texten tritt der Elativ ʾašqā nicht mehr auf, dafür erscheint in zwei Suren der Positiv šaqiyy

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r1.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r1.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r1.claim: The second stanza again addresses the messenger: he first praises God, perhaps with close followers, then speaks to a wider audience with an admonition that makes verse 6’s revelation public in purpose.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r1.anchor: Das zweite Gesätz beginnt wie das erste mit einem Aufruf an den Verkünder

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r4.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r4.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r4.claim: Verses 10–11 contrast good and bad responses to proclamation; verse 11 expands the bad response with a conventional warning of Hell, balanced by the promise to the good in verses 14–15.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r4.anchor: Auf den das zweite Gesätz einleitenden Aufruf folgt in V. 10.11 eine Antithese

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r5.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r5.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r5.claim: The passage forms a chiasm: the responses of good and bad in verses 10–11 correspond to their fates in verses 12–15, as in Q 92:5–11 and 14–21.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:9-15:kommentar/r5.anchor: Zusammen mit der an den Guten gerichteten Verheißung V. 14.15 ergibt sich eine chiastische Struktur

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:9/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:9/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:9/r5.claim: Only those who fear God benefit from admonition; the wretched who reject God avoid it, and verse 12 says such avoidance leads to hell.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:9/r5.anchor: ondan ancak Allah’tan korkanların faydalanacağı, Allah’tan korkmayan, isyan ve günah batağına saplanmış olan bedbahtların ise ondan kaçacakları bildirilmiştir

ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r1.claim: Those who avoid the reminder avoid the admonition itself; al-ashqā is the unbeliever firmly denying resurrection or any premise that could produce fear of God.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r1.anchor: ويتجنبها أي ويتجنب الذكرى ويتحاماها الأشقى وهو الكافر المصر على إنكار المعاد

ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r2.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r2.claim: One view identifies the most wretched as the especially hostile unbeliever, such as al-Walid ibn al-Mughira and ʿUtba ibn Rabiʿa; a report says the verse was revealed about them.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r2.anchor: وقيل المراد الكافر المتوغل في عداوة الرسول صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم كالوليد بن المغيرة وعتبة بن ربيعة

ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r3.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r3.claim: Other views take the term as all unbelievers, who are more wretched than sinners, or unbelievers of this community, whose believers are more blessed than earlier communities' believers; Alusi prefers the earlier interpretation.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p108#2/r3.anchor: وقيل المراد به الكافر مطلقا فإنه أشقى من الفاسق وقيل المفضل عليه كفرة سائر الأمم

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r6.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r6.claim: The most wretched person, in God’s foreknowledge, will shun and distance himself from the reminder.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r6.anchor: أي يتجنب الذكرى ويتباعد عنها {الأشقى} الشقي في علم الله

BAYDAWI-FULL:87:9-12/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:9-12/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:9-12/r4.claim: The most wretched avoids the reminder; this means either the unbeliever, who is worse than the sinner, or the most deeply immersed of unbelievers.
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:9-12/r4.anchor: { الأشقى } الكافر فإنه أشقى من الفاسق، أو { الأشقى } من الكفرة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r1.claim: Love for God is shown by following, while aversion is shown by avoiding the reminder, refusing it, and innovating against it.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r1.anchor: وعلامة الحب الاقتداء , وعلامة البغض التجنب والانتهاء

BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r2.claim: The most wretched person makes himself resist the reminder from the noblest messenger and is absolutely wretched because he opposes the greatest messenger and does not fear.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r2.anchor: لأنه خالف أشرف الرسل فهو لا يخشى فكان أشقى الناس

BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r3.claim: Believers in Muhammad are nobler than those who believed in earlier messengers.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r3.anchor: من آمن به أشرف ممن آمن بمن قبله من الرسل

BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r6.claim: The passage uses ellipsis by correspondence: fear and happiness in the first group imply the omitted hard-heartedness and misery of the second, while the second group's cause and outcome imply the first group's opposites.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r6.anchor: ذكر الثمرة في الأول وهي الخشية دليلا على حذف ضدها من الثاني

BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r7.speaker: الملوي
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r7.claim: Al-Mulawi says Quranic eloquence pairs cause and outcome across passages, avoiding repetition; he illustrates decree, execution, and allocation through the planning and operation of a waterwheel.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p399/r7.anchor: قال الملوي : ولا شك أن القرآن العظيم على أحسن ما يكون

ABUHAYYAN:87:11/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:87:11/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:87:11/r1.claim: The feminine pronoun refers to the reminder, which the most wretched person avoids.

ABUHAYYAN:87:11/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:87:11/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:87:11/r2.claim: The Messenger's unbeliever is the most wretched among disbelievers, while one who believes in him and his message surpasses believers in earlier messengers.
ABUHAYYAN:87:11/r2.anchor: لأن الكافر بالرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم هو أشقى الكفار

ALUSI:87:11/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:11/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI:87:11/r1.claim: The pronoun refers to the reminder: the wretched person avoids and shuns admonition.
ALUSI:87:11/r1.anchor: أي ويتجنب الذكرى ويتحاماها { الاشقى } وهو

ALUSI:87:11/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:11/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI:87:11/r2.claim: Al-Ālūsī prefers the unbeliever who persistently denies resurrection and other matters that should evoke fear.
ALUSI:87:11/r2.anchor: وهو الكافر المصر على إنكار المعاد ونحوه الجازم بنفي ذلك مما يقتضي الخشية

ALUSI:87:11/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:11/r3.speaker: قيل
ALUSI:87:11/r3.claim: One view identifies him as an unbeliever deeply hostile to the Messenger, such as al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīrah and ʿUtbah ibn Rabīʿah; a report says the verse was revealed about them.
ALUSI:87:11/r3.anchor: وقيل المراد به الكافر المتوغل في عداوة الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم كالوليد

ALUSI:87:11/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:11/r4.speaker: قيل
ALUSI:87:11/r4.claim: Another view identifies him with any unbeliever, who is more wretched than a grave sinner.
ALUSI:87:11/r4.anchor: وقيل المراد به الكافر مطلقاً فإنه أشقى من الفاسق

ALUSI:87:11/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:11/r5.speaker: قيل
ALUSI:87:11/r5.claim: A further view compares this community's unbelievers with other nations' unbelievers: as its believers surpass theirs in blessedness, its unbelievers are more wretched.
ALUSI:87:11/r5.anchor: وقيل المفضل عليه كفرة سائر الأمم فإنه حيث كان المؤمن من هذه الأمة

BAGHAWI:87:11/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:87:11/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:87:11/r1.claim: He avoids the reminder and keeps away from it.
BAGHAWI:87:11/r1.anchor: { ويتجنبها } يعني : يتجنب الذكرى ويتباعد عنها

BAGHAWI:87:11/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:87:11/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:87:11/r2.claim: The most wretched is the wretch in God's knowledge.

BAYDAWI:87:11/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:87:11/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:87:11/r1.claim: Al-ashqā may mean the disbeliever, more wretched than a sinner, or the most wretched of disbelievers because of deep immersion in unbelief.
BAYDAWI:87:11/r1.anchor: ويتجنبها ويتجنب الذكرى الأشقى الكافر فإنه أشقى من الفاسق أو الأشقى من الكفرة لتوغله في الكفر

BIQAI:87:11/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:87:11/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI:87:11/r1.claim: Love of God is marked by emulation; aversion for God's sake appears as avoidance, refraining, innovation, and refusal.
BIQAI:87:11/r1.anchor: وعلامة الحب الاقتداء ، وعلامة البغض التجنب والانتهاء والابتداع والإباء

BIQAI:87:11/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:87:11/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI:87:11/r2.claim: The wretched person forces himself and his originally upright nature to avoid the reminder delivered by the noblest creature, closest to the Creator.

BIQAI:87:11/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:87:11/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI:87:11/r3.claim: The supreme wretch rejects the noblest messenger and so fears nothing; those who believe Muhammad are nobler than believers in earlier messengers.
BIQAI:87:11/r3.anchor: الذي له هذا الوصف على الإطلاق لأنه خالف أشرف الرسل فهو لا يخشى

DURR:87:10/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:87:10/r1.speaker: قتادة
DURR:87:10/r1.claim: Qatada says everyone who fears God remembers His reminder; one who shuns it from disdain and hatred for it and its people is among the most wretched.
DURR:87:10/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله : { سيذكر من يخشى ويتجنبها الأشقى }

IBNASHUR:87:11/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:11/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:11/r1.claim: Tajannub means moving away; its form evokes taking a position at the side of something, figuratively seeking distance from it.
IBNASHUR:87:11/r1.anchor: وأصله تفعل لتكلف الكينونة بجانببٍ من شيء

IBNASHUR:87:11/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:11/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:11/r2.claim: The definite article marks a class, so al-ashqā means the most wretched people generally.

IBNASHUR:87:11/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:11/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:11/r3.claim: In religious usage, wretchedness is the afterlife state of humiliation and torment arising from unbelief; one who dies a believer is not wretched.
IBNASHUR:87:11/r3.anchor: والشقوة والشقاء في لسان الشرع الحالة الناشئة في الآخرة عن الكفر من حالة الإهانة والتعذيب

IBNASHUR:87:11/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:11/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:11/r4.claim: Ibn ʿĀshūr takes al-ashqā to mean the unbeliever, the most wretched because of eternal residence in Hell, including all polytheists.
IBNASHUR:87:11/r4.anchor: هو الكافر لأنه أشدّ الناس شقاء في الآخرة لخلوده في النار

IBNASHUR:87:11/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:11/r5.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNASHUR:87:11/r5.claim: Some commentators instead take the definite description as referring specifically to al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra or ʿUtba ibn Rabīʿa.
IBNASHUR:87:11/r5.anchor: ومن المفسرين من حمله على العهد فقال :  أريد به الوليد بن المغيرة

IBNASHUR:87:11/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:11/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:11/r6.claim: The following description, “the one who enters the greatest Fire,” clarifies the otherwise ambiguous “most wretched” for the early audience.
IBNASHUR:87:11/r6.anchor: ووصف { الأشقى } ب { الذي يصلى النار الكبرى } لأن إطلاق { الأشقى } في هذه الآية

IBNASHUR:87:11/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:11/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:11/r7.claim: The contrast implies that the most wretched do not fear: absorbed in delusion and pleasure, they make no effort to escape their misery.
IBNASHUR:87:11/r7.anchor: ومقابلة { من يخشى } ب { الأشقى } تؤذن بأن { الأشقى } من شأنه

IBNATIYYA:87:11/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:87:11/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:87:11/r1.claim: The most wretched, whose misery was decreed, rejects the reminder and its benefit by disbelieving.
IBNATIYYA:87:11/r1.anchor: ويتجنب الذكرى ونفعها من سبقت له الشقاوة فكفر

IBNKATHIR:87:11/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:87:11/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:87:11/r1.claim: The wretched person avoids the reminder and enters the great Fire: he neither dies to rest nor lives a beneficial life, but remains conscious of painful punishment. This is echoed in 43:77 and 35:36.
IBNKATHIR:87:11/r1.anchor: لا يموت فيستريح ولا يحيا حياة تنفعه ، بل هي مضرة عليه ؛ لأن بسببها يشعر ما يعاقب به من أليم العذاب

IBNKATHIR:87:13/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:87:13/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:87:13/r1.claim: The wretched person avoids the reminder and enters the great Fire: he neither dies to rest nor lives a beneficial life, but remains conscious of painful punishment. This is echoed in 43:77 and 35:36.
IBNKATHIR:87:13/r1.anchor: لا يموت فيستريح ولا يحيا حياة تنفعه ، بل هي مضرة عليه ؛ لأن بسببها يشعر ما يعاقب به من أليم العذاب

KASHSHAF:87:11/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:87:11/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:87:11/r1.claim: The most wretched avoids and shuns the reminder.

KASHSHAF:87:11/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:87:11/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:87:11/r2.claim: One explanation identifies the most wretched as an unbeliever, who is more wretched than a sinner.

KASHSHAF:87:11/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:87:11/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:87:11/r3.claim: Alternatively, he is the most wretched of unbelievers because of his intense enmity toward the Messenger.
KASHSHAF:87:11/r3.anchor: أو الذي هو أشقى الكفرة لتوغله في عداوة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم .

KASHSHAF:87:11/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:87:11/r4.speaker: قيل
KASHSHAF:87:11/r4.claim: An unnamed report says the verse was revealed about al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra and ʿUtba ibn Rabīʿa.
KASHSHAF:87:11/r4.anchor: وقيل : نزلت في الوليد بن المغيرة وعتبة بن ربيعة .

MAWARDI:87:11/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:87:11/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI:87:11/r1.claim: The most wretched person who avoids the reminder is the disbeliever, made wretched by disbelief.
MAWARDI:87:11/r1.anchor: يعني يتجنب التذكرة الكافر الذي قد صار بكفره شقيا

NASAFI:87:11/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:87:11/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI:87:11/r1.claim: The most wretched person keeps away from the reminder and does not accept it.
NASAFI:87:11/r1.anchor: ويتباعد عن الذكرى فلا يقبلها { الأشقى } الكافر

NASAFI:87:11/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:87:11/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI:87:11/r2.claim: “The most wretched” may mean the unbeliever generally or the most wretched of unbelievers because of deep hostility to the Messenger.
NASAFI:87:11/r2.anchor: { الأشقى } الكافر أو الذي هو أشقى الكفرة لتوغله في عداوة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

NASAFI:87:11/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:87:11/r3.speaker: قيل
NASAFI:87:11/r3.claim: It is said that the verse was revealed concerning al-Walid ibn al-Mughira and Utba ibn Rabi'a.
NASAFI:87:11/r3.anchor: قيل : نزلت في الوليد بن المغيرة وعتبة بن ربيعة

QURTUBI:87:11/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:11/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI:87:11/r1.claim: The wretched person avoids the reminder and keeps away from it.
QURTUBI:87:11/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى : " ويتجنبها " أي ويتجنب الذكرى ويبعد عنها

QURTUBI:87:11/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:11/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI:87:11/r2.claim: Al-ashqā is the one known in God's knowledge to be wretched.
QURTUBI:87:11/r2.anchor: " الأشقى " أي الشقي في علم الله

QURTUBI:87:11/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:11/r3.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI:87:11/r3.claim: One reported occasion identifies the verse's subject as al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra and ʿUtba ibn Rabīʿa.
QURTUBI:87:11/r3.anchor: وقيل : نزلت في الوليد بن المغيرة وعتبة بن ربيعة

RAZI:87:11/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:11/r1.speaker: author
RAZI:87:11/r1.claim: Since the knowledgeable and non-hostile doubters fear and benefit from preaching, the most wretched is the hostile denier who refuses the call and avoids its reminder, entering the greater Fire.
RAZI:87:11/r1.anchor: لابد وأن يكون لهما خوف وخشية ، وصاحب الخشية لابد وأن يستمع

TAB:87:11/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:87:11/r1.speaker: author
TAB:87:11/r1.claim: Al-ashqā is the more wretched of the two parties, who will enter the great Fire; these are those whom the reminder did not benefit.
TAB:87:11/r1.anchor: الذكرى الأشْقَى يعني :  أشقى الفريقين الّذي يَصْلَى النّارَ الكُبْرَى

TAB:87:11/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:87:11/r2.speaker: قتادة
TAB:87:11/r2.claim: Qatada warns that whoever shuns the reminder out of disdain for it and hatred of its people is plainly wretched.
TAB:87:11/r2.anchor: عن قتادة ،   قوله :  فَذَكّرْ إنْ نَفَعَت الذّكْرى سَيَذّكّرُ مَنْ يَخْشى

QURTUBI:87:14/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:14/r15.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
QURTUBI:87:14/r15.claim: A report through Ata from Ibn Abbas says 87:14 concerns Uthman, who replaced a hypocrite's leaning date tree with an orchard after the Prophet's offer of a tree in Paradise was refused; 87:11 concerns the hypocrite. No grading is stated.
QURTUBI:87:14/r15.anchor: وروى عنه عطاء قال : نزلت في عثمان بن عفان رضي الله عنه . قال : كان بالمدينة منافق كانت له نخلة

FARRA:v3p256/r10.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p256/r10.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p256/r10.claim: The most wretched person avoids the reminder and does not remember.

NAHHAS:v5p205/r16.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p205/r16.speaker: الحسين بن وقاد
NAHHAS:v5p205/r16.claim: Al-Husayn ibn Waqad identifies the most wretched as ʿUtba ibn Rabiʿa, al-Walid ibn al-Mughira, and Umayya ibn Khalaf.
NAHHAS:v5p205/r16.anchor: قال عتبة بن ربيعة والوليد بن المغيرة وأمية بن خلف

ZAJJAJ:v5p315#2/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p315#2/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p315#2/r5.claim: The most wretched person avoids the reminder; the verb's understood object is al-dhikra.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p271/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p271/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p271/r1.claim: The Prophet should not pursue the obdurate or force the message: he is to remind when useful, while the fearful heed it and the wretched evade it and face their fate.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p271/r1.anchor: The Prophet (sws) is directed not to go after the stubborn and the obdurate.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r6.claim: The verses distinguish those who heed the warning from those who evade it; their rejection reflects their own condition, not a flaw in the message or preacher.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r1.claim: Evaders treat this life as all that exists and fear no Hereafter; they face eternal Fire, neither living nor dying, and will wish in vain for death.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r1.anchor: They regard this life to be all that there is.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r2.claim: Those who preserve nature's God-given light recognize a prophet's call, or awaken when prompted; where that light is extinguished, only the Judgement trumpet can awaken them.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p279/r2.anchor: people in whom this light has been totally extinguished

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r10.claim: The feminine object that the most wretched avoid is the reminder; the most wretched are those who disbelieve in the Messenger.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r10.anchor: هؤلاء هم العلماء والمؤمنون كل على قدر ما وفق له. يتجنبها

DURR-FULL:v8p483/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p483/r7.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p483/r7.claim: Whoever fears God is surely reminded; only the wretched shun the reminder out of disdain for it and its people.
DURR-FULL:v8p483/r7.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله: {سيذكر من يخشى ويتجنبها الأشقى} قال: والله ما خشي الله عبد قط إلا ذكره

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p470/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p470/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p470/r4.claim: Those who fear God and the Hereafter will heed the reminder, while the one destined for misery rejects it and faces the Fire.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p470/r4.anchor: سيذكر من يخشى الله والدار الآخرة، وهم العلماء والمؤمنون كل بقدر ما وفق

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r18.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r18.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r18.claim: The most wretched person who avoids the reminder is the unbeliever made wretched by unbelief.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r18.anchor: { ويتجنبها الأشقى } يعني يتجنب التذكرة الكافر الذي قد صار بكفره شقيا

TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r4.claim: For the wretched the first reminder completes the proof and leads to avoidance; more reminders do not benefit, so turn away.
TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r4.anchor: والتذكرة للأشقى الذي لا خشية في قلبه لأول مرة تفيد تمام الحجة

THALABI:v10p184/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p184/r8.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p184/r8.claim: The wretched person, so in God's knowledge, avoids and keeps away from the reminder.
THALABI:v10p184/r8.anchor: يتجنبها يعني ويتجنب التذكرة ويتباعد عنها
